messages:
maria (AE): Hey team — FinTech POC asked for demonstrable access records + admin activity for their vendor risk review. They want: retention policy, export/forwarding options for SIEM, sample logs (for forensic review), and statement about immutability. Can we confirm what we can hand them for a PoC?

jason (SE): We can provide three things: 1) live audit log stream (syslog/S3 export), 2) queryable historical logs via the Console API, 3) a redacted sample bundle.

carlos (Solutions Eng): For the PoC I suggest we do an S3 export of audit logs for a 7-day window and a short live syslog forwarder to their Splunk instance. That gives them both batch + near-realtime.

lee (InfoSec): They specifically asked for fields they care about: actor (user/service), actor_ip, api_key_id (or token hash), action (model.generate, model.deploy, config.change), object (model_id, route), timestamp, outcome (success/fail), request_id. Make sure sample shows admin role usage.

irene (SRE): Defaults: hosted customers get 90 days searchable logs in Console; audit export to S3 is configurable and we can set lifecycle/prune rules. For Dedicated/Private we can do customer-managed retention (we've had customers keep logs 3+ years).

audit-bot (automated): SIG questionnaire entry updated: "Audit logging: API and Admin actions are logged; logs can be exported to customer-managed S3 or forwarded via syslog. Retention configurable for Dedicated/Private. Hosted default 90 days." Link: https://intra.redwood/tools/sig-answers/1849994321

maria (AE): Do we have a short sample log (redacted) we can attach to the RFP? Ideally one that shows an admin key rotation, a model rollback, and a failed auth attempt.

carlos (Solutions Eng): I'll generate a redacted sample bundle. Plan: enable export for a small window, pull the objects, redact emails/api keys, produce a gzipped bundle + CSV summary. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

jason (SE): Also include a curl example for their forensics team to pull logs via API. e.g.:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \
  "https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/audit/logs?start=2026-03-15T00:00:00Z&end=2026-03-22T00:00:00Z&format=ndjson" \
  -o sample-logs.ndjson
```

maria (AE): Perfect. What about immutability / tamper-evidence? They asked for "immutable audit trail" language for the vendor questionnaire.

lee (InfoSec): For hosted we can't promise write-once storage, but we provide append-only audit records with system-level checksums and time-based integrity markers, and we maintain write-restricted controls on the audit pipeline. For Dedicated/Private we can integrate with customer-managed WORM S3 buckets or HSM-backed KMS to meet stricter WORM requirements. I'll draft a concise blurb.

irene (SRE): We also publish access logs for the control plane actions (who accessed Console) and deploy events. We can provide a signed, time-stamped export of the PoC window if they need chain-of-custody.

maria (AE): Pricing question from procurement: is there an incremental cost for the S3 export or syslog forwarding during PoC?

jason (SE): For short PoC windows we waive export fees — operationally we treat PoC exports as part of onboarding. For sustained production exports there is a small egress/config fee (we'll quantify in the SOW).

carlos (Solutions Eng): Action items: 1) I'll drop redacted sample bundle + README to a temp S3 link (expires in 7 days). 2) I'll include a sample ndjson and CSV mapping. 3) I'll add a short playbook for configuring syslog forwarder in Console.

lee (InfoSec): I'll provide the SIG/CAIQ snippet they need for the security questionnaire Q: "Do you provide admin activity logs with export capability?" Suggested answer: "Yes. Administrative and API activities are recorded in our audit pipeline and can be exported to customer-managed storage (S3) or forwarded to customer SIEM via syslog. Retention and immutability options vary by deployment model; please see attached export and retention options."

maria (AE): Great — I'll bundle the sample + lee's SIG blurb + jason's pricing note and send to the customer. Customer asked for a single PDF they can attach to their VRM portal — can someone help assemble?

carlos (Solutions Eng): I can create the PDF from the README + sample log excerpt + instruk. Will include minimal redaction notes.

irene (SRE): FYI: for the signed export we need a ticket to ops. Carlos, ping me when you’re ready to create the signed artifact (include start/end timestamps and justification).

maria (AE): Thanks all. Estimated deliverables & owners: sample logs (carlos) by EOD tomorrow; SIG blurb (lee) by EOD today; pricing confirmation (jason) in 24h; assemble/send (maria) once pieces arrive.

jason (SE): One more technical note to include in the PDF: logs include token hash (not full token), model_prompt_snippet (truncated), and request_id to correlate with traces. That helps forensic investigators map events without exposing sensitive prompt contents.

maria (AE): Awesome. If anything blocks the export (permissions / legal) raise here and we’ll escalate. :thumbsup:

carlos (Solutions Eng): Will do.

lee (InfoSec): Adding final: we can also generate a sample Splunk ingestion config (HEC/syslog) if they need it.

maria (AE): OK — I'll follow up with the customer to schedule a short handoff call once we have the bundle. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
